objective: Harden ordinary teaching gradebook release and rollback routes so unsafe gradebook update path identifiers are rejected before external audit reads or release writes.

codeReferences.summary: The release route now resolves and validates the gradebook update objectId before external audit adapter creation and audit readback.
The rollback route now resolves and validates the gradebook update objectId before external audit adapter creation and audit readback.
The release route-level safe-id guard returns a stable redacted 400 error for unsafe gradebook update ids.
The rollback route-level safe-id guard returns the same stable redacted 400 error for unsafe gradebook update ids.
Regression proves unsafe release object ids do not trigger external audit reads or local writes.
Regression proves unsafe rollback object ids do not trigger external audit reads or local writes.

redGreenEvidence.observedFailure: Both new route-boundary regressions returned 404 'Gradebook update was not found.' instead of the expected redacted 400, showing the unsafe path parameter reached external audit lookup flow before validation.

redGreenEvidence.observedPass: 2 focused tests passed; release and rollback unsafe object ids returned redacted 400 responses and external audit fetch arrays remained empty.

securityPosture.ordinaryTeachingRoute: Gradebook release and rollback now reject unsafe object ids before external teaching-operation audit readback, ownership lookup, provider synchronization, append, rollback, or local JSON writes.
securityPosture.rbacBoundary: Teacher authentication and production auth-provider readiness still run first; unsafe gradebook object ids are denied immediately after that trusted identity boundary and before resource lookup.
securityPosture.redaction: The unsafe path-like gradebook id, storage token variable value, external origin, and local data directory are not echoed in the response.
securityPosture.productionPersistence: The regression uses production-style external teaching-operation storage configuration and proves no external audit request is made for unsafe gradebook object ids.

aggregateEnterpriseGateImpact.summary: This closes a narrow ordinary teaching direct-call route-boundary gap for gradebook release and rollback. The full enterprise gate still requires same-run owner-approved production evidence for env placement, deployment, storage, ordinary teaching route/browser smokes, app-auth readiness, browser workflow smoke, and live provider generation.
